picks.editorial_note: TUM's robotics spinout RobCo became the university's 24th unicorn, crossing a one-billion-euro valuation — a major financial validation of AI-driven industrial robotics research translating into market impact.
picks.title: RobCo: TUM’s 24th unicorn

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon launched a dedicated joint Science Hub, institutionalizing a decade-long partnership into a formal academic-industry research pipeline for autonomous systems and AI.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell's Dr. Olivier Elemento won an NIH Director's Pioneer Award to build an AI-agent-driven discovery engine for generating cancer research hypotheses, a high-prestige recognition of AI's growing role in biomedical science.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: A CWRU alumnus's startup Neurophos is building optical computing chips that use light instead of electronic circuits, directly targeting the energy costs that threaten to bottleneck AI's continued scaling.
picks.title: A CWRU entrepreneur studied invisibility cloaks. Now he’s working to cut AI’s energy use | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: A King's College London/Stanford analysis of 1.25 billion job ads across 41 countries found generative AI adoption is linked to a net employment increase, offering rare large-scale empirical evidence in the AI-jobs policy debate.
picks.title: AI adoption linked to increase in employment globally | King's College London

picks.editorial_note: A WashU-led team secured a $4.25 million DARPA grant to fuse AI with physics-based simulation for fuel injector design, a significant defense-research investment in physics-informed AI.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: An NSF CAREER Award will fund FSU research into large language models for analyzing complex numerical data at scale, with direct applications to healthcare analytics.
picks.title: FSU data scientist receives NSF CAREER Award to develop AI model to analyze complex numerical data at scale

picks.editorial_note: Brown engineers built a brain-inspired imaging system that can see through fog by mimicking retinal responses, a notable sensing breakthrough with applications from autonomous vehicles to search-and-rescue.
picks.title: Brown University engineers build brain-inspired imaging system that can ‘see’ through fog

picks.editorial_note: CERN's federated learning platform CAFEIN was recognized at the UN's Digital@UNGA Awards for enabling privacy-preserving, cross-institutional AI model building, underscoring growing international validation of collaborative AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: CERN’s AI innovation recognised at Digital@UNGA Awards 2026 – Home

picks.editorial_note: A Clemson-led team is researching how generative AI produces harmful content to develop safeguards protecting young people from AI-generated sexual content, addressing an urgent child-safety policy gap.
picks.title: New safeguards could help protect young people from unsafe content generated by artificial intelligence
